references.text: The same expression 'strengthen your heart with a piece of bread' is used again when the father-in-law repeatedly persuades the Levite to stay
Abraham offers hospitality with bread to strengthen the heart, using the same expression for hospitality and a meal
Earlier in the same story where the father-in-law shows hospitality and persuades the Levite to stay
Samuel and Saul rise early in the morning, a similar expression for getting up early and preparing to depart
Lot offers hospitality to the angels and asks them to rise early and continue on their way, a similar pattern of hospitality
